interpretation.honesty: Simulated endpoints only. Not a trial, not FDA/EMA readiness, not Phase II.
interpretation.A_equals_B: Under Q3W/5-2 discretization, A (MTD) and B (Gatenby) produced identical OS/PFS/RECIST on this GBM LHS (log-rank p=1, Cox HR=1). That is a computed result, not a claim that the policies are biologically equivalent.
interpretation.PFS_vs_PR: E/F can post more RECIST-like PR while showing earlier PFS because PD is nadir-relative: a dip-then-rebound crosses +20% over nadir sooner than monotonic growth from baseline.
interpretation.E_vs_A_os: OS log-rank p and Cox CI include no-difference (HR CI crosses 1); treat as inconclusive for OS benefit.
interpretation.F_vs_A_os: OS log-rank and Cox HR+CI are computed from the virtual cohort; they are in-silico mapping scores, not a clinical effect.
